## fastnoise-lite.js — FastNoiseLite JS port
- Source: https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoiseLite (npm fastnoise-lite-1.1.1)
- Version: 1.1.1 (npm tarball fastnoise-lite-1.1.1.tgz, pulled 2026-10-23)
- License: MIT (Jordan Peck / contributors; header comment in file; package.json)
- Note: FastNoiseLite is the portable sibling of FastNoise2, by the same
  author (Auburn). FastNoise2 itself is C++/SIMD with no shipped JS/WASM

- File: pristine, unmodified (pure ES module, `export default class FastNoiseLite`).
- SHA-256: 83cdfcdc9f65e02b4a8ea6fc157283119379b316b28b0021e9cc0f4d15de01bb

## FastNoise2 (not vendored — [RESEARCHED])
- Source: https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoise2 — MIT (verified via GitHub API).
- The SIMD C++ node-graph library. No official JS/WASM build exists; building
  one needs emscripten (not available on this VM). Documented path:
  emscripten-build the FastNoise2 C++ → wasm, wrap node-graph API for the
  browser. Until then, FastNoiseLite (above) covers runtime noise.
